title: MrBeast Spends About $1M Per Video
description:
Why would a YouTuber spend 1 million dollars on one video?

Sources:
- Wikipedia: MrBeast: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/MrBeast

From the cited page: dropped out of college in late 2016; by 2022 about $1 million per flagship video (reported); brand sponsorships and AdSense primarily fund the videos and he reinvests the revenue; first YouTuber past 300 million subscribers on July 10 2024; Fortune estimated his net worth at about $2.6 billion in 2026. Not financial advice.

#shorts #mrbeast #youtube #howtheymakemoney

scenes.narration: Why would a YouTuber spend 1 million dollars on one video?
In 2016, he quit college. Just him and a camera.
But sponsors and ads pay for each video.
Then it all goes back in. Bigger videos, bigger deals.
Now Fortune puts his net worth near 2.6 billion dollars.
